title: sweep: dead-surface deletions — 7 zero-consumer items, one claim, one PR (findings-triage batch 2026-08-09)
body:
Created by the maintainer-authorized one-off triage pass (2026-08-09, registered on objectstack#6015). Same shape as objectstack's spec sweep cards (#6486 family): **one claim, one PR, N `Fixes` lines** — the member cards stay open as `finding` and are ⛔ **excluded from individual selection**; they close when this sweep's PR merges.

## Members (each verified zero-consumer by its own filing; re-verify premise at claim time)

| Card | Deletion |
|---|---|
| #3901 | `form-view.ts` spec bridge's dead `spec.aria` read (key retired upstream, can never fire) |
| #3778 | 4 `views:{objectName}` cache invalidates with no cache writer — delete the dead invalidates (do NOT wire a cache nobody asked for) |
| #3775 | second `mergeViewsIntoObjects` in `@object-ui/core` — zero consumers, drifted semantics |
| #3773 | `RecordContextValue.loading` / `.error` — zero producers, zero consumers (if the implementing dev finds wiring them as cheap as removing, per the #3460 `refresh` precedent, STOP and ask — default is remove) |
| #3731 | `buildObjectDetailPageSchema` — zero callers since MetadataDetailPage retired |
| #3740 | `@object-ui/plugin-report`'s `react-dom` peer declaration — never imported; keep the UMD external mapping, drop the peer row |
| #3736 | object-detail custom widget's 60 lines of hardcoded Chinese copy — dormant code, zero callers; delete the dead widget body rather than translating dead text (AGENTS.md #-1) |

## Rules

- Deletions only — no rewiring, no capability additions; any member that turns out to have a live consumer at claim time gets dropped from the PR with a comment on its card, not "fixed" speculatively.
- Changeset per repo convention; each member's card cited in the PR body with its `Fixes` line.
